sections.heading: Norwood Grand project facts
sections.text:
- 348 units in four 11-storey blocks at 2, 6, 8 and 10 Champions Way, Woodlands. Developer: CDL Stellar Pte. Ltd., a CDL subsidiary. [CDL news release](https://www.cdl.com.sg/assets/en-newsroom-press-release-pdf/CDL-News-Release-Norwood-Grand-launch-weekend-web.pdf)
- 99-year lease from 18 December 2023. TOP obtained August 2026 (CDL construction update, 2 November 2026). [CDL construction page](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/construction/)
- Unit sizes from about 495 to 1,335 sq ft, depending on type. [CDL brochure](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/norwoodgrand/brochure.pdf)

Maison is an independent interior design firm, not affiliated with CDL. Key and access appointments are set per owner and are not confirmed here.

sections.heading: About these concepts and plans
sections.text: The four theme pictures on this page are AI-generated style concepts by Maison for a Norwood Grand renovation. They are not photos of an actual unit, not completed Maison projects and not surveyed layouts; layouts, fittings and views are illustrative. Each look leans on built-in carpentry, the kind of Woodlands condo interior design that Maison plans for Champions Way homes. The floor plans are the original pages 16 to 21 of the [Norwood Grand brochure by CDL](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/norwoodgrand/brochure.pdf), scaled only. They are subject to change and final survey, so confirm your own unit plan, stack and any mirroring before adapting an idea.

faq.q: Which unit types do the floor plans cover?
faq.a: Pages 16 to 21 of the [CDL brochure](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/norwoodgrand/brochure.pdf) show every type from 1-Bedroom + Study (A1S, 46 sqm / 495 sq ft) to 4-Bedroom Premium + Study (D3PS, 124 sqm / 1,335 sq ft), with the (P) variants on the same pages. The brochure notes that areas include the balcony and PES where applicable and that plans are subject to final survey. Confirm your exact stack, floor and any mirrored version.

faq.q: Which finishes are supplied, and which are proposals?
faq.a: Official specifications give porcelain living/kitchen tiles, vinyl bedrooms, laminate/melamine kitchen cabinets with quartz tops, melamine wardrobes, B1 induction appliances, 2.70m living/bedroom and 2.40m kitchen ceilings. CDL names Bosch/Samsung appliances and Geberit/Hansgrohe bathroom fittings. Exact colours, models, cabinet internals and as-built locations need handover verification. [Finishes/developer source](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/norwoodgrand/floorplans/specifications.pdf). Maison-inspired colours, furniture, lighting and joinery treatments do not prove supplied finishes or a previous Maison commission.

No. They are AI-generated style concepts, not photos of a Norwood Grand unit and not completed Maison projects. Room shapes, fittings, furniture and window views are illustrative. Use your approved plan and a measured site survey for construction. Compass facing and real views are not implied.
TOP obtained August 2026. Individual key/access appointments remain unconfirmed. Building TOP does not authorise tenant/owner renovation. [Timing source](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/construction/).

faq.q: What must happen before move-in or occupation?
faq.a: Inspect and log defects; agree rectification and access; survey and freeze scope; obtain management/landlord requirements and work-specific authority approvals; procure, build, test and inspect; confirm completion/occupation requirements and moving arrangements. Condo/EC and office rules differ from HDB residential rules. No exact approval lead time, deposit, permitted hours or move-in date is verified. A moderate home scope may use 6–10 on-site weeks, or modest office 8–12 weeks, only as an editorial planning allowance after access/approvals—not a guarantee.

faq.q: What other project details should I check?
faq.a: Project-wide facilities, amenities and the original unit mix do not establish your own view or unit details. Ask for your approved owner documents before committing to works.
